speaker: husband
text: [tired] Loretta, please. [sighs] Loretta, please. I come from a very long session at work.

speaker: loretta
text: [sarcastic] Oh. [pause] And I assume you were working with Lisa.

speaker: husband
text: [exasperated] Loretta, please. Not this again. [firmly] She is just a co-worker.

speaker: loretta
text: [mocking] Oh yes? [fast] Then why is she always, always messaging you? [shouting] And all those little hearts I see?

speaker: husband
text: [bitter] Your father never liked me. [pause] [hurt] He called me a clank.

speaker: loretta
text: [shouting] Oh my god, let it go! [fast] It was sixteen years ago and he didn't mean it!
